hook: Defence subsidiary expands capacity via QIP

summary: Bharat Forge has invested Rs 290.5 crore into its wholly owned defence subsidiary, Kalyani Strategic Systems, via a rights issue. This investment strengthens the financial backing of Bharat Forge's defence vertical.
